newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Donaghys to demerge Scott Technology.
newsitem.headline: Donaghys to demerge Scott Technology.

text.p: New Zealand cordage textiles, electronics and packaging company Donaghys Ltd said on Friday it planned to demerge Scott Technology from the group and establish it as a single industry public company.

"To achieve this demerger and the separate Stock Exchange listing of Scott Technology Ltd, the directors have resolved to declare a special 'in specie' dividend of five shares in Scott Technology Limited for every eight shares in Donaghys and this special dividend will be fully imputed," Donaghys said.
Donaghys said it would concentrate on its manufacturing, exporting and importing business through Donaghy's Industries and Arthur Ellis Limited.
The Group's brands, including EnviroTex, Techweb, Fairydown, Great Outdoors and Columbia, would be further developed, particularly in the Asian markets.
Shareholder entitlements will be determined on March 27 and entitlement letters sent to Donaghys shareholders on April 3.

"The separate stock exchange listing of Scott Technology will mean that shareholders will own the same number of shares in Donaghys, which will continue as a dedicated manufacturer, distributor, exporter and importer," the company said.

It was proposed that both Donaghys and Scott Technology would pay interim and final dividends from 1998 and it was anticipated that the combined dividends will not be less than the present Donaghys dividend.
Scott Technology designs and builds manufacturing systems for the whitegoods industry.
